semantic_evidence.original_quote: Compare the top 5 TSs by CR count against their section counts (complexity vs. change frequency).
semantic_evidence.finding: Compare the top5 TSs by CR count against their section counts explicitly requests the TS identity, CR count and Section count for each selected TS. specNumber/crCount/sectionCount close those three roles with nonnull string/integer/integer types. The complexity vs change frequency purpose does not explicitly request a correlation coefficient, causal claim, per-release distribution, individual CR names or section titles; such outputs are optional explanations rather than mandatory answer fields.
query_clauses: WITH specNumber, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount
RETURN specNumber, crCount, count(DISTINCT sec.sectionId) AS sectionCount
ORDER BY crCount DESC, specNumber ASC

    | CQ3. CR 연결 | Meeting 번호 DESC | CR 번호 ASC |
    | CQ4. Resolution 연결 | Meeting 번호 DESC | Resolution ID ASC |
    | CQ5. 통합 분석 | Count DESC | TS 번호 ASC |

    | CQ 유형 | 기본값 | 적용 CQ |

    | Top N 조회 | 10 | CQ2-3~2-4, CQ5-4 |
    | 단일 조회 | 1 | CQ1-7 |
    | 전체 조회 | 전체 | CQ1-3 (breadcrumb) |

    | 항목 | 제약 | 비고 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | **CR → Section 직접 연결** | Appendix A [P3-V05] 참조 | clausesAffected 필드 있는 CR만 |

    | **TS 버전** | **release별 final** (release-aware). 각 (specNumber, release)마다 Spec 노드를 두고, 해당 release final 버전을 specVersion에, release를 specRelease/specInRelease에 기록 | 전체 minor-version 이력은 미적재(release당 final 1개). Spec IRI = `tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}` |

semantic_evidence.finding: One TS-family member is identified by specNumber. CR document nodes have unique recorded tdocNumber identities; draft/pCR records can lack a formal CR number, so counting only numeric crNumber or deduplicating formal spec+CR would silently change the original class unit. count(DISTINCT cr) removes join multiplicity to hub/edition witnesses. Section identities are release-aware, and count(DISTINCT sec.sectionId) counts each original recorded Section once across that family; it does not collapse different retained releases into a single invented edition. Sequential aggregates prevent a CR×Section product.
query_clauses: WITH specNumber, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount
RETURN specNumber, crCount, count(DISTINCT sec.sectionId) AS sectionCount
ORDER BY crCount DESC, specNumber ASC

## 5. CQ 결과 규칙

    ### 5.2 결과 개수 (Default Limit)
    
    | CQ 유형 | 기본값 | 적용 CQ |

    | 목록 조회 | 10 | CQ1-1~1-10, CQ2-1~2-2, CQ3-1~3-6, CQ4, CQ5-1~5-3 |
    | Top N 조회 | 10 | CQ2-3~2-4, CQ5-4 |
    | 단일 조회 | 1 | CQ1-7 |
    | 전체 조회 | 전체 | CQ1-3 (breadcrumb) |
    
    ---
    
    ## 6. 제약사항
    
    | 항목 | 제약 | 비고 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | **CR → Section 직접 연결** | Appendix A [P3-V05] 참조 | clausesAffected 필드 있는 CR만 |
    | **Resolution → CR 연결** | Appendix A [P3-V06] 참조 | Resolution이 CR을 references하는 경우만 |
    | **TS 버전** | **release별 final** (release-aware). 각 (specNumber, release)마다 Spec 노드를 두고, 해당 release final 버전을 specVersion에, release를 specRelease/specInRelease에 기록 | 전체 minor-version 이력은 미적재(release당 final 1개). Spec IRI = `tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}` |
    | **TS 범위** | RAN1 관련 | 38.201, 38.202, 38.211-215, 38.291 |
    
    > **specVersion·release 추출 규칙 (release-aware)**: 각 TS를 release별 디렉토리(`data/corpus/tsg/RAN/formal/TS/{WG}/source/{spec}/{release}/`)의 final docx에서 적재하고, release·version 정본은 cover-page에서 추출(`scripts/tsg/RAN/formal/common/phase-0/ts_cover_metadata.py` — `(Release N)` + `3GPP TS NN.NNN V x.y.z`)하여 파일명 버전코드(base-36, letter=major)와 교차검증한다(불일치 시 cover 우선). 각 (specNumber, release)마다 Spec 노드, specVersion=해당 release final.
    > 
    > - 파일명 패턴: `{5자리 specNumber}-{버전코드}.docx` (예: `38214-j10.docx`)
    > - 버전 코드 → 시맨틱 버전 변환: 알파벳(a=10, b=11, ..., j=19, k=20) + 2자리 숫자 → `{major}.{minor}.0` (예: j10 → 19.1.0)
    > - 이 변환 로직은 Phase-5 `extract_tr_version_from_filename()`과 동일하다
